scope: CS, Data Science, Statistics, Information, AI, Robotics
notes: Approved by the UT System Board of Regents Feb 2026, opening fall 2026. Unites three existing units inside the College of Natural Sciences rather than creating a standalone college. Peter Stone (CS chair and Texas Robotics founder) named Special Adviser for School Formation. CS had moved from Engineering to Natural Sciences and gained autonomy via an MOU with the dean around 2005.
